**Article Details for PMID: 24095248**

**Title:** Statins and cognition: a systematic review and meta-analysis of short- and long-term cognitive effects.

**Authors:** Kristopher J Swiger, Raoul J Manalac, Roger S Blumenthal, Michael J Blaha, Seth S Martin

**Journal:** Mayo Clinic proceedings
**Publication Date:** 2014-01-09
**DOI:** 10.1016/j.mayocp.2013.07.013

**Abstract:**
To evaluate the effect of statins on short-term cognitive function and the long-term incidence of dementia.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
